personas.description: Older first-time computer users (for example, a 76-year-old grandma).

risk_catalog.title: Unverified generated code
what_can_go_wrong: Code compiles but does the wrong thing.
guardrails: Require executable tests for generated logic before release.
Require static analysis and dependency vulnerability checks.
Require human review for auth, payments, data, and networking code.

risk_catalog.title: Prompt ambiguity
what_can_go_wrong: Agent optimizes for wrong success criteria.
Features are implemented inconsistently across platforms.
guardrails: Require structured prompts with objective, constraints, and acceptance tests.
Require the agent to restate the requested outcome before coding.
Require explicit non-goals to avoid scope drift.

risk_catalog.title: Unsafe handling of secrets and personal data
what_can_go_wrong: API keys are hardcoded and leaked.
Personal data is logged or exposed.
Unencrypted transport or storage is used.
guardrails: Never commit secrets; use secure secret stores.
Minimize collected data and redact logs by default.
Enforce encryption in transit and at rest where applicable.

risk_catalog.title: Inaccessible or unusable UX
what_can_go_wrong: First-time users cannot complete core flows.
Interfaces are not readable or understandable.
guardrails: Require simple language, clear feedback, and guided onboarding.
Require accessibility checks (contrast, focus, labels, navigation).
User-test with at least one true beginner persona before release.

risk_catalog.title: Platform mismatch
what_can_go_wrong: Solution relies on APIs unavailable on target device.
Performance is unacceptable on low-end hardware.
guardrails: Declare target platform constraints before implementation.
Test on representative low-end and high-end devices.
Define failure modes for offline, latency, and partial connectivity.

risk_catalog.title: No release quality gate
what_can_go_wrong: Prototype code is shipped as production code.
Breaking changes reach users without rollback.
Incidents cannot be diagnosed due to missing observability.
guardrails: Define required checks for each goal type (hobby vs state-of-the-art).
Require staged release with rollback strategy.
Require baseline logging, monitoring, and error reporting.

minimum_requirements: Basic functional test of core flow
Clear disclaimer that reliability is best effort
Backup and recovery plan for user data
Comprehensive CI with tests and static analysis
